name: sparse-dft-driver
description: Operate Sparse-DFT standalone or as the Sparse-DFT engine adapter for DFT_Skills and original-result evidence handoff for Academic_Writing_Skills.

clouds_coder.runtime_contract: Keep generated projects outside the skill. Use actual Sparse-DFT source/catalogue and executable. Standalone mode performs the whole computational workflow; linked mode preserves the upstream research plan/manifest/spine. Do not confuse convergence with native or production validity. RAG is optional and follows supplied/local inputs. Preserve PAW, units, weighted sampling, hashes and evidence scope; unsupported physics remains explicit. Reuse identifiable project accuracy evidence; cases check actual run convergence and outputs, not a repeated global precision audit. Select a relevant scientific case; new sparse/spin/DOS routes have dedicated cases.
